title: Someone is really dumb or really cheap or both.
text:
Someone is really dumb or really cheap or both.. [[VIDEOID:42de44fe450b334d8fb74f9373706407]] Seller Vacuum Power seals these to save on shipping costs. They are 🧽 SPONGES!!!!! They already weigh next to nothing!
Sellers attempt to save themselves money actually destroys the product! These small light sponges can never recover to original shape therefore cannot be fully effective plus they just look like crap in the pool. I bought these to rid my pool of excess oil. Now I still have excess oil PLUS what appears to be trash floating about.😒🤦‍♀️

product_metadata.title: Boao 16 Pieces Creamy Oil Absorbing Sponge for Hot Tub Swimming Pool and Spa
